messages.manageSettings.vans.title: Furgonët tuaj
messages.manageSettings.vans.help: Menaxhoni furgonët tuaj. Secili ka ekranin e vet të porosive dhe cilësimet e veta.
messages.manageSettings.vanBilling.title: Shtoni një furgon tjetër
messages.manageSettings.vanBilling.body: Paketa juaj {plan} përfshin {vans, plural, one {# furgon} other {# furgonë}}. Shtimi i një furgoni tjetër kushton {price}.
messages.nativeShell.setup.noVanBody: Ky food truck ende nuk ka asnjë furgon aktiv. Aktivizoni një te Cilësimet → Furgonët tuaj dhe kjo pajisje do të konfigurohet automatikisht — nuk ka hapa të tjerë këtu.
messages.manageMenuImport.settingsReview.anchorDi: Cilësimet → Furgonët tuaj → Cilësimet e shfaqjes
messages.designEditor.settings.lastToggle: {kind, select, weekly {Mbani aktiv të paktën Vendndodhjen ose Orën. messages.weeklyPostApi.shortened.venue: Emri i vendit nuk u përshtat dhe u shkurtua.
messages.socialPosts.lookOwnHint: Kjo kuti ka fontin, ngjyrën dhe efektet e veta. Zgjidhni “Njësoj si: I gjithë teksti” për ta përputhur sërish me të tjerat.
messages.serviceSettings.sameSettingsConfirm: Të kopjohen cilësimet e Furgonit 1 në çdo furgon? Kopjohen të gjitha cilësimet e furgonit nga Furgoni 1, ashtu si me “Njësoj si: Furgoni 1” te Cilësimet. Kapaciteti i kuzhinës ka çelësin e vet.

back.manageSettings.vans.title: Your vans
back.manageSettings.vans.help: Manage your vans. Each has its own order screen and its own settings.
back.manageSettings.vanBilling.title: Add another van
back.manageSettings.vanBilling.body: Your {plan} plan includes {vans, plural, one {# van} other {# vans}}. Adding another van costs {price}.
back.nativeShell.setup.noVanBody: This food truck has no active van yet. Activate one in Settings → Your vans and this device will set itself up automatically — there are no other steps here.
back.designEditor.settings.lastToggle: {kind, select, weekly {Keep at least Location or Time on. A cancelled event shows its place crossed out and the word CANCELLED, so if both are off there would be nothing to show it is cancelled.} other {Keep at least Venue name or Time on. A cancelled event shows its place crossed out and the word CANCELLED, so if both are off there would be nothing to show it is cancelled.}}
back.weeklyPostApi.shortened.venue: The venue name did not fit and was shortened.
back.socialPosts.lookOwnHint: This box has its own font, colour and effects. Choose “Same as: All text” to match it with the others again.
back.serviceSettings.sameSettingsConfirm: Copy Van 1’s settings to every van? All of Van 1’s van settings are copied, just as with “Same as: Van 1” in Settings. Kitchen capacity has its own switch.
